verdict.summary: The design record and implementation-site comment remain internally consistent and match the referenced checkout. They accurately identify that target-controlled gate code runs directly on the runner with outbound network and public log output, while distinguishing the independently reviewed, SHA-bound auto-arm path and its trust-surface audit. The proposed increments are explicitly fail-closed, preserve existing purge, tree-seal, no-token-after-gate, and audit controls, and require non-vacuous exact-token tests plus live TCP, DNS, and print controls. The prior round had no findings, and I found no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in this round.
